notes: Rule 425 filing of SLRC's 8-K (Item 1.01) with the Agreement and Plan of Merger (Exhibit 2.1) and joint press release (Exhibit 99.1), all inside one document block (seq=1). Two-step merger: Merger Sub into SUNS, then SUNS into SLRC; SLRC survives. Exchange ratio is not fixed: it equals SUNS per-share NAV / SLRC per-share NAV, determined within 48 hours before the Effective Time; the press release gives an illustrative ratio of approximately 0.7763 (NAVs as of 2021-09-30), so exchange_ratio is null. Cash only in lieu of fractional shares, so cash_per_share is null. No collar is mentioned. The 'other' condition covers the closing NAV determinations and the SLRC base management fee reduction letter agreement (also accuracy of representations and absence of material adverse effect in the merger agreement). Tax opinion condition is from merger agreement Sections 8.2(d)/8.3(d). Termination fees of approximately $25,604,700 (third party acquiring SLRC pays SUNS) and $7,572,270 (third party acquiring SUNS pays SLRC) are stated but have no merger-schema field. Meeting and record dates are not set in this filing.
